title: Cambrian：传统独栋住宅与通勤便利性的平衡
title_en: Cambrian: classic single-family homes and a workable commute
intro: 95124 覆盖 Cambrian 一带的重要住宅区域。这里有大量成熟的低层住宅街区，购房者通常会比较传统独栋、院子空间、房屋翻新需求和通勤条件。
intro_en: 95124 covers much of the Cambrian area, with established low-rise neighborhoods. Buyers usually compare classic single-family homes, yard space, how much updating a home needs, and the commute.
buyer: 重点核实屋顶、排水、管道、电气系统、地基状况，以及加建部分是否有许可。不能只看翻新后的厨房和地板。Cambrian 内部的学校边界也需要逐地址确认。
buyer_en: Look hard at the roof, drainage, plumbing, electrical and foundation, and confirm that any additions were permitted. A new kitchen and floors do not tell you those things. School boundaries inside Cambrian also need checking address by address.
seller: 对这一带的传统独栋房屋，专业的上市前 Inspection、必要维修、合理的 Staging 和精准的可比成交分析，通常比笼统强调“好学区”更有说服力。
seller_en: For classic homes here, a pre-listing inspection, needed repairs, sensible staging and a sharp set of comparable sales usually do more than a general “great schools” pitch.

note.zh: Redfin 截至 2026 年 9 月的三个月统计中，95124 的成交中位价约 $1.88M，同比下降 6.1%，提醒卖家不要把上一年高峰价格直接作为当前定价依据。
note.en: In Redfin’s three months ending September 2026, the 95124 median sale price was about $1.88M, down 6.1% from a year earlier. Last year’s peak is not a pricing basis for today.
